method: Purposive sample of 10 unique employer postings, 10 employers. Adjacent titles grouped by agent-building duties; not a labor-market estimate. Six full live employer pages with application forms; four Ashby employer-indexed descriptions whose direct rendering needs JavaScript, so current application status unconfirmed. Skills may be duties or preferred, not always required. Salary is not comparable across seniority/geography.

postings.title: AI Engineer / AI Agent Engineer
postings.experience: Production software track record and hands-on LLM project; no exact years required
postings.pay: Omitted: indexed versions conflict ($110–200k vs $150–210k); currency not explicit
postings.evidence: Production APIs/data/testing/debugging; LLM/agent projects; eval framework and context engineering; coding-agent use with human accountability. Agent-specific framework skills may be learned on job.

postings.title: AI Agent Engineer (Coding Agent)
postings.experience: Shipped and operated agentic production systems; no exact years found
postings.pay: Salary and equity; no numeric range
postings.evidence: Agent harnesses, long workflows, regression/failure taxonomies, model routing, tracing; strong Python/TypeScript and distributed systems. MCP and fine-tuning are bonuses.

postings.title: AI Agent Engineer – US Remote
postings.experience: Deep backend/systems experience; senior/staff expectations described
postings.evidence: Python preferred; tool-use/memory/planning framework, RAG and evaluation loops, auditable safety, latency/success/hallucination measures, analyst augmentation.

postings.title: AI Agent Engineer — Patient Intake
postings.experience: No fixed years; demonstrated built/tested/improved agents
postings.evidence: Python/TypeScript or comparable, APIs/databases, planning/retrieval/memory, systematic evaluations, failure-mode analysis, monitoring and human escalation. HIPAA and RAG are nice-to-have.

postings.title: Agentic Engineer
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.experience: Production agent systems and enterprise delivery experience; no numeric years
postings.evidence: Python or Java; agent workflows, APIs/MCP, evals/guardrails, state/memory, traceability, token cost and latency; AWS/Azure; containers/CI/CD; security reviews and client communication.

postings.title: AI Engineer, Agent Platform
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.location: Mountain View, CA; application specifies five days onsite
postings.experience: AI product with real users; side project/internal tool/open-source/MVP accepted as evidence
postings.evidence: Runtime orchestration, eval/trace harness, retrieval/ranking/compression/memory, model cost decisions, Python or Go/Node plus React/Next.js. Public artifact preferred.

postings.title: Backend Engineer (Python), AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.experience: Intermediate; production Python backend and LLM-framework/AI-backend experience
postings.evidence: Python, LangGraph/LangChain flows, REST/GraphQL APIs, pytest and agent evaluations; on-call/root-cause/observability; async written collaboration.

postings.title: Frontier Agents Engineer (Applied AI)
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.experience: 4+ years software, ML or applied AI
postings.pay: USD $180,000–225,000 base for listed SF/NY/Seattle range; equity separate
postings.evidence: Python, production LLM systems, retrieval/memory/tool-use; quantitative experiments, golden sets, LLM judges and human evaluation; safety, observability/cost. Cloud and Docker/Kubernetes preferred.

postings.title: AI Agent Engineer
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.experience: 5+ years AI/ML; 1+ year production agent/LLM; AI startup or product-team experience
postings.pay: USD $180,000–225,000; range may include variable compensation
postings.evidence: Agent orchestration/planning/memory/error recovery; RAG chunking/vector DB/embedding/reranking; eval suites; CI/CD and code review. No particular language requirement found.

postings.title: AI Agent Engineer
postings.status: Full employer page and application form live
postings.location: Boston or San Francisco/Berkeley hybrid, two office days
postings.experience: 3+ years solutions engineering or technical consulting; bachelor's related field
postings.evidence: Python/Java or similar; API/data/cloud integration; customer discovery, demos, technical documentation and post-sales troubleshooting. Cloud certification preferred. Despite title, duties resemble solutions engineering, not explicit agent-harness design.
